name: Shoujo Byouteki Ren'aichuu
source:
I, Maiko Ogawa (name changeable), am a student at the Yukareno Academy!
I like my calligraphy teacher, and want to get into a school that's nearby,
but if I don't reach certain goals, my happy school life may come to an end...!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE250146.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我，小川舞子（化名），是汤加雷诺学园的学生！
我喜欢我的书法老师，想考附近的学校，
但如果没有达到某个目标的话，我快乐的学校生活可能就会结束……！？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE250146.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
